property_summary: The `getAssertionPolicy` function returns `blockAssertion` as `false` for any assertion ID.
Calling assertionDisputedCallback does not block the assertion (blockAssertion remains false).
After calling assertionDisputedCallback, the blockAssertion flag in getAssertionPolicy for any assertion ID remains true.
The blockAssertion policy is false for any assertion ID after calling assertionDisputedCallback.
The getAssertionPolicy returns blockAssertion as false for every assertionId.
The return value of getAssertionPolicy for any assertionId must have validateDisputers set to false.
Calling getAssertionPolicy for any assertionId must return the same validateDisputers value before and after calling assertionDisputedCallback.
After calling assertionDisputedCallback with any bytes32 assertionId, the contract does not revert.
The assertionDisputedCallback does not modify assertionResolvedCallback state.
After calling assertionDisputedCallback, the contract still has the same behavior for assertionResolvedCallback (i.e., it does not revert when called).
After calling assertionDisputedCallback, calling assertionResolvedCallback does not revert.

After calling assertionDisputedCallback with any bytes32 assertionId, the contract's assertionResolvedCallback function still reverts when called with the same assertionId and any bool assertedTruthfully.
The assertionDisputedCallback function must only be callable by the optimisticAsserter contract address.
Only the optimistic asserter can successfully call assertionDisputedCallback — any other caller causes a revert.
The assertionResolvedCallback function must only be callable by the optimisticAsserter contract address.
Only the optimistic asserter address can successfully call assertionDisputedCallback; other callers revert.
The onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier in assertionDisputedCallback should revert when called by any address other than the optimisticAsserter contract address.
The assertionDisputedCallback function always succeeds (does not revert) for any bytes32 input.
